entries.title: A fix for a false positive can install a false negative
entries.summary: `confidence: 1.0` is documented as **provably unreachable**. That is a claim about the tree, and it was computed from the index with nothing in between.

entries.title: A rate written for a future date is wrong for every day before it
entries.summary: `tools` is serialised ahead of system and messages, so every byte of the published tool list sits in the cached prefix -- **4,184 B across six tools**, measured. Changing any of it invalidates that prefix and every turn behind it, for every session on every install. `benchmarks/tier_switch/` priced that at 174

entries.title: An install created before a default can never learn there is a choice
entries.summary: `tool_surface` is written into a config exactly once, by `_fresh_config_content` on a genuinely first-ever install, and is deliberately kept out of `generate_template` so `upgrade_config` can never back-inject it. That freeze is correct: it is what stops a package update silently collapsing a user's tool
